name: Figma
description:
The Figma MCP server helps you pull in Figma context and generate high-quality code that aligns with your codebase and design intent. Use the MCP server to retrieve code resources from Figma Design or Make files, and turn your ideas into production apps.

 **Key features:** 
• **Generate code from selected frames or nodes** - Select a frame in Figma or provide a node URL to have an AI agent turn your design into code. 
• **Extract design context from layers** - Pull out variables, components, and layouts from a design to ensure builds adhere to design patterns. 
• **Code smarter with Code Connect** - Boost output quality by reusing your actual components, the MCP server informs AI agents about existing components derived from Code Connect information. 
• **Map your flows with diagrams** - The Figma MCP server can turn your Claude prompts into flow charts, Gantt charts, or other diagrams in FigJam. 

 **Note:** The get_screenshot tool is currently limited to returning a descripton of screenshots in Figma when called in Claude and Claude Code. See developer term [here](https://www.figma.com/legal/developer-terms/)

_published_faq.name: How do I add Figma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Figma to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.figma.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: Is Figma MCP ready for ChatGPT and Claude?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of September 16, 2026, Figma scores 0/100 on Manufact's MCP publishing checklist. The scan does not yet meet ChatGPT publishing checks and does not yet meet Claude publishing checks. Passing these checks does not guarantee marketplace approval.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Figma MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Figma provides these MCP tools: generate_diagram, get_design_context, get_screenshot, get_metadata, create_design_system_rules, get_variable_defs, get_code_connect_map, get_figjam, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Figma?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Figma in design-creative on the Manufact MCP catalog include Motion, MotionVid, Sleek, Streamloop MCP, and Image Generation.
Figma requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Why is Figma failing MCP readiness checks?

acceptedAnswer.text: Figma scored 0/100 on the latest Manufact MCP publishing checklist, below the 70-point checklist threshold. The top failing check is MCP negotiation succeeds (v1/v2). Failed to connect: Authentication required Paste the MCP URL into the Manufact MCP catalog to rerun the scan.
Figma is developed by Figma. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
